title: An Analytical Model of Compute-limited Multistage Training Pipelines
abstract: arXiv:2611.13276v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern foundation models are trained through multiple stages, yet how these stages interact and how compute should be allocated across them remain poorly understood. We introduce an analytically tractable high-dimensional model combining unsupervised pretraining with a linear autoencoder, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with noisy stepwise labels, and reinforcement learning (RL) with sparse episodic rewards. Using random matrix theory and an operator-projection closure, we derive approximate low-dimensional learning dynamics that closely match simulations. We show that finite pretraining data imposes a representation-dependent performance limit, with Bayes classification error scaling as the inverse square root of the pretraining sample ratio, and observe the same exponent in asymptotic SFT and RL errors. translated_title: 算力受限的多阶段训练流水线解析模型
translated_abstract: 现代基础模型需要经过多个阶段进行训练，然而这些阶段之间如何相互作用、算力应如何在各阶段之间分配，目前仍缺乏充分理解。我们提出了一个解析可处理的高维模型，将基于线性自编码器的无监督预训练、带有噪声分步标签的监督微调（SFT），以及具有稀疏回合奖励的强化学习（RL）结合在一起。利用随机矩阵理论和算子投影闭合方法，我们推导出与仿真结果高度吻合的近似低维学习动力学。我们证明，有限的预训练数据会造成依赖于表示的性能上限，其贝叶斯分类误差按预训练样本比例的平方根倒数缩放，并且在SFT和RL的渐近误差中观察到相同的指数。更好的预训练还能降低对噪声监督的敏感性。SFT初始化可以缩短由稀疏奖励引起的RL初始平台期……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文构建了一个解析可处理的高维多阶段训练理论模型（预训练+SFT+RL），揭示了算力在各训练阶段的分配规律，并证明有限的预训练数据会带来依赖表示的性能上限，其误差按预训练样本比例平方根的倒数缩放。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an analytically tractable high-dimensional model of multistage training pipelines (pretraining, SFT, RL) that reveals how compute should be allocated across stages and proves that finite pretraining data imposes a representation-dependent performance ceiling, with errors scaling as the inverse square root of the pretraining sample ratio.
